text:
alex: kicking off staged rollout: v2.4.0 -> 5% canary in us-west. change window: 3h. tagging release notes in PR #421. deploy-bot: /deploy canary v2.4.0 --percent=5 --region=us-west
deploy-bot: Canary started: rollout_id=rl-3501, version=v2.4.0, target=5%, state=running, link=https://deploy.redwood/rl-3501
maya: observability dashboards warming up, no anomalies yet :eyes:
tom: quick heads-up — embedding route /api/embed has a small 2xx->5xx blip in the tail, checking logs
sre-oncall: linking logs: https://logs.redwood/q/rl-3501 errors look like downstream 504s, not our tokenization
tom: spike aligns with a throttling change on the infra side? hitting a new upstream timeout
alex: rolling back option ready if ERR_RATE > 0.8% or 5xx increase > 2x baseline. agreed?
product-ops: request to confirm we included the release notes line about tokenization fix
alex: yes added in PR, small note: "kv-cache fix for long context". PR link: https://git.redwood/pr/421
maya: perf looks fine for generation route, latency stable, embed tail spike only on small sample
sre-oncall: can we temporarily reduce concurrency for canary to let KV cache warm without affecting traffic?
tom: +1. deploy-bot, can you patch concurrency? command: `/deploy patch rl-3501 --concurrency=4`
deploy-bot: Patch applied: rl-3501 concurrency=4, state=running
maya: metrics re-evaluating... tail errors dropping back to baseline after 90s :thumbsup:
alex: can we proceed to 15% in us-west and 5% in eu-west? want gradual overlap
tom: prefer hold at 5% for another 10m to confirm no regression in embed path
product-ops: change window still clear until +3h, but let's avoid EU if we have doubt
alex: holding at 5% in us-west. scheduling 10m recheck. tagging @oncall for quick rollback call if needed
sre-oncall: oncall here. monitoring alerts set: err_rate > 0.8% OR mean_5xx_rate * 2 triggers rollback
deploy-bot: Alert rule attached to rollout rl-3501
maya: after 10m looks stable. if tail stays <0.6% can we move to 15% in us-west only?
tom: agree. but if any embed 5xx cluster appears, we soft-rollback to v2.3.0 for embeds only
alex: plan: 15% us-west, wait 20m, run a small sample evaluation on 1k embed requests, if pass continue
product-ops: confirm release notes updated with fallback instructions and rollback contact list
alex: done. notes include: "rollback to v2.3.0 for embed route via pin command" and contact list
deploy-bot: Promoting canary: `/deploy promote rl-3501 --percent=15 --region=us-west`
deploy-bot: Promotion started: rl-3501 -> 15% us-west. state=running
sre-oncall: seeing a fresh bump in embed 5xx from a narrow IP range, isolating now
maya: bump is small but sustained, investigating cache warm vs upstream routing
tom: isolating traffic by tagging requests from suspect IP range and replaying locally
alex: decision time: if 5xx sustains beyond 10m at >0.8% we rollback. otherwise continue and monitor closely
sre-oncall: 5m in, rate holding at 1.1% on embeds (above threshold). recommending rollback
tom: agree with rollback. I can pin embed route to v2.3.0 while we debug v2.4.0
product-ops: we should notify CS and watchers, prepare a short note
alex: execute rollback for embed route only. deploy-bot run: `/deploy rollback --rollout=rl-3501 --routes=/api/embed --target_version=v2.3.0`
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: routes=[/api/embed], target=v2.3.0, state=rolling_back
deploy-bot: Rollback complete for /api/embed. rl-3501 adjusted: global percent=15, embed route pinned to v2.3.0
maya: after pin embed 5xx dropped back to baseline. other routes unaffected
sre-oncall: keeping an incident watch for 30m. creating short postmortem note in #postmortems if continued
tom: will capture diagnostic logs and the failing request ids, pushing a follow-up PR to revert the specific change in v2.4.0 embed handler
product-ops: sent update to CS: "Embed route temporarily pinned to v2.3.0 due to elevated 5xxs during canary. No action required from customers." link sent
alex: thanks team. leaving rollout at 15% for non-embed traffic, embed pinned. we will reopen EU rollout after fixes and another canary
maya: adding a follow-up eval job to run 5k sample embed requests against a debug branch
alex: ok. closing this thread once follow-up PR is opened. :white_check_mark:
